title: Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta
summary: A silky, softly set cream panna cotta speckled with seeds from two vanilla pods.

ingredients.note: about 7 g; check the pack says beef (bovine)
2 pods give the dense speckle; extra pods to garnish (optional)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Steep
steps.text: split the pods, scrape the seeds into the cream with the sugar and salt, add the pods and heat to steaming. Cover off the heat and steep 20 min. Steeping draws the full flavour from the pods.

steps.title: Soften gelatine
steps.text: meanwhile sprinkle the gelatine over the cold milk and leave 5 min. Cold liquid lets the gelatine swell evenly.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: rewarm the cream until steaming, take off the heat, lift out the pods and whisk in the milk and gelatine until dissolved. Strain into the jug.

steps.title: Thicken slightly
steps.text: stand the jug in the iced water and stir gently 8-10 min until it feels like single cream; this keeps the seeds suspended instead of sinking. Slightly thickened cream holds the seeds in place.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: pour into the moulds and chill on the tray at least 6 h.

steps.title: Unmould
steps.text: dip each mould briefly in hot water, loosen the edge and turn out. Garnish with a rinsed vanilla pod. A quick dip loosens the edge without melting it.

tips: A common mistake is pouring the cream into the moulds while it is hot, so all the seeds sink; cool it over ice first.
Lightly oil the moulds if you are nervous about turning them out.
Rinse and dry used pods and keep them in sugar.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Do not freeze.
